title: pangolin observer heartbeat
description: Pangolin is a synthetic subscriber-only vendor: subscribes to `**` to observe everything that crosses the router, and emits this low-rate heartbeat so it remains visible as a peer node in panoscope (pure subscribers otherwise have no outgoing edges to render).

sample_topics.description: Up to 8 distinct topics observed in the last 30s. Sample-not-summary; the full count is in distinct_topics_30s.
